result.instructions: Tools for ServiceM8, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are still waiting for a quote this week?"; "Show the jobs and scheduled bookings for client Harbour Plumbing next Monday."; "Which staff members are active, and what is their role?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ServiceM8 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run servicem8_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run servicem8_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run servicem8_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. servicem8_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: servicem8_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders, quotes, completed and unsuccessful jobs) with status, address, client and dates. Filter by status, active or edit_date. Page with next_cursor. ServiceM8 API: GET /job.json.

filter.description: OData filter on public field names, e.g. status eq 'Work Order' and active eq 1. Operators: eq, ne, gt, lt. Up to 10 conditions joined by 'and'. String values in single quotes.

sort.description: Sort expression, e.g. edit_date desc. Cannot be combined with cursor.

cursor.description: Page cursor: send -1 (or omit) for the first page, then the next_cursor from the previous call. Keep the same top.

tools.name: servicem8_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by uuid: status, job and billing address, description, client, category, queue and invoice or payment fields. ServiceM8 API: GET /job/{uuid}.json.

tools.name: servicem8_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job with a status and optional client, address, description, category and purchase order number. Returns the new job uuid. Creates data in the customer's ServiceM8 account. ServiceM8 API: POST /job.json.

status.description: Job stage: Quote, Work Order, Unsuccessful or Completed.

job_address.description: Address where the work is done.

tools.name: servicem8_update_job
tools.title: Update a job
tools.description: Change fields of one job. ServiceM8 requires status on every job update: pass the new status, or the current one to keep it. Other fields change only when passed. Repeating the same call gives the same result. ServiceM8 API: POST /job/{uuid}.json.

status.description: Job stage. Required on every update: the new stage, or the current one to keep it.

job_address.description: Address where the work is done.
